title: The link between galaxy merger, radio jet expansion, and molecular outflow in the ULIRG IRAS 00183−7111
question: What is the link between galaxy merger, AGN ignition, radio jet expansion and kpc-scale molecular outflow in the ULIRG IRAS 00183-7111?

data.sensitivity: Continuum: 18 uJy/beam (100 GHz), 20 uJy/beam (250 GHz). Line (20 km/s channels): 0.22 mJy/beam for CO(1-0), 0.23 mJy/beam for CO(3-2)

what.value: 2.3 GHz VLBI continuum map, radio core position, and radio power log P_2.3GHz = 25.8 W Hz^-1

recipe.goal: Create CO moment maps and position-velocity diagrams
recipe.method: Masked moment technique: smooth a copy of the cleaned cube spatially with a Gaussian (FWHM = 1.5x synthesized beam) and in velocity with Hanning smoothing, apply a 0.9 sigma flux-density threshold to create a 3D mask, and compute moments 0, 1, and 2 from the un-smoothed cubes within the mask; extract PVDs along slits A, B, and C
key_parameters: spatial smoothing FWHM = 1.5x synthesized beam, velocity smoothing = Hanning, mask threshold = 0.9 sigma

recipe.goal: Extract integrated CO spectra, fit line profiles, and measure integrated flux densities
recipe.method: Extract spectra from un-smoothed cubes within polygonal areas drawn by-eye around line structures; fit single and double Gaussian components using lmfit; integrate flux density over FWZI velocity range where channel intensities >= 3 sigma
key_parameters: FWZI threshold >= 3 sigma; 1-Gaussian vs 2-Gaussian models (mean, sigma, normalisation free)
assumptions: Systemic velocity of each CO line corresponds to nominal redshifted central frequency at optical systemic velocity (z = 0.3282)

recipe.goal: Calculate molecular gas luminosity and total molecular gas mass
recipe.method: Calculate L'_CO from integrated CO(1-0) flux density following Carilli & Walter (2013) and convert to M(H2) using alpha_CO following Bolatto et al. (2013)
assumptions: ULIRG CO-to-H2 conversion factor alpha = 0.8 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1

recipe.goal: Construct CO(3-2)/CO(1-0) line ratio map and evaluate gas excitation
recipe.method: Re-image both CO datasets with identical channel count, channel width (20 km/s), pixel and image size, common uv range, and convolved to a common beam (0.42'' x 0.32''); create masked moment 0 maps and divide them using CASA task immath
key_parameters: channel width = 20 km s^-1, common beam = 0.42'' x 0.32''
assumptions: Local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE) and optically thin conditions for R31 > 20

recipe.goal: Perform optical isophotal analysis, 2D light modelling, and merger simulation comparison
recipe.method: Mask bright field sources on sky-subtracted i-band VST image, run IRAF ELLIPSE for radial profiles of ellipticity, PA, and surface brightness, build 2D axisymmetric model with IRAF BMODEL, subtract from original image and smooth residual with Gaussian filter (sigma = 1); visually compare morphology with GALMER merger simulations
key_parameters: Gaussian filter standard deviation sigma = 1 for residual map visualization; galaxy centre fixed by-eye at geometrical centre

recipe.goal: Estimate molecular outflow mass, energetics, and driving mechanisms
recipe.method: Extract CO(1-0) spectrum in a 1.0'' x 0.3'' box along slit C, integrate high-velocity channel wings to get M_out, compute outflow velocity, mass outflow rate, depletion time, momentum rate, and kinetic power; compare with supernova driving, AGN radiation pressure, and dynamical radio jet models
key_parameters: extraction box = 1.0'' x 0.3'', r_out = 1.0'' (~5 kpc) [or 7'' (~34 kpc) including diffuse component], C = 3
assumptions: Constant average volume density in a cone or sphere (C = 3); blueshifted component moves directly along observer line of sight; alpha_CO = 0.8; gas density = 10^4 cm^-3 for jet model; AGN bolometric correction L_BOL = 83 x L_X,2-10
